headline: 2027 State Budget Is a Turning Point in Reducing Dependence on Oil - Vugar Gulmammadov
summary: Commentary describes Azerbaijan's 2027 state budget as a turning point in reducing dependence on the oil and gas sector. It balances military, social and investment spending.
why: Azerbaijan is a major oil and gas exporter, so its budget and fiscal diversification plans shape the country's sovereign finances and economic outlook.
